critical_code_review_comments: worker_telemetry.compute_system_status() correctly aggregates last_successful_send_at from scheduler_loop preferentially with fallback to global last_ok across all workers — matches the iter context note. Diagnostic fields are spread into ALL return paths (paused, no-workers/warming-up, normal) so the UI never sees a missing field.

Iter-102 thresholds are correctly inverted from the prior 'error_rate > 0.0 → yellow' bug: green branch (line 315) requires <5% error AND zero stale AND zero missing; the 0.3%-within-tolerance reason still surfaces in green-mode for transparency without flipping the level. Verified live: 0% errors → green / all_expected_workers_fresh.

PortalOpsPage SystemSignalLight wraps the title attribute as `Operational · <reasons>` — the live render shows 'Operational · all_expected_workers_fresh' which is exactly what the review request specified. The 4-tile diagnostics grid renders in two collapsed/expanded states gated behind the Workers toggle button; both states keep the data-signal-level attribute on the root, which is the right pattern for headless tests that don't need to expand.

LiveSendPulse poll cadence raised 4s→8s (line 26 const POLL_INTERVAL_MS=8000) and BroadcastFeed 6s→12s (line 32 const POLL_MS=12000). The 16s observation window now reliably yields 2-3 calls (1 immediate + 1 at 8s + sometimes 1 at 16s) — confirming the throttle without breaking the live UX (last-send tile still updates within ~10s).

Avatar resolveSrc() correctly falls back to local path when REACT_APP_AVATAR_CDN_BASE is empty — verified by visible <video> src starting with /avatars/master/. When the user later sets the env var, the same code path will rewrite to the CDN base. Single-video architecture from Iter 100/101 is intact (no preload <video> element).

rca_of_the_issue: n/a — Iter 102 is a feature shipment, not a bug fix. The previous false-positive 'DEGRADED' that prompted this iter was caused by `error_rate > 0.0` flipping the engine to yellow on a single historical worker error. Iter 102 raises the threshold to error_rate >= 0.05 (5%) for yellow and >= 0.25 (25%) for red; 0% errors classify green; live verification shows level='green', heartbeat_status='fresh', reasons=['all_expected_workers_fresh']. Diagnostic fields (last_successful_send_at, last_warning_at, last_warning_message, queue_latency_sec, heartbeat_status) are spread into the response from compute_system_status() and surfaced in the UI under [data-testid=signal-diagnostics]. Polling throttle (LiveSendPulse 4s→8s; BroadcastFeed 6s→12s) halves dashboard backend load — verified by counting 3 POSTs in 16s vs the pre-iter 4-12. CDN env var is intentionally empty in dev; resolveSrc() correctly falls back to local /avatars/master/* paths.
